item.title: Sandbox
item.description: The sandbox is a practice copy of DefectDojo Pro under /sandbox/ on your own instance. It has its own database, preloaded with sample data, so you can try imports, rules, reports and workflows, train new people, or rehearse a change without touching production. Nothing done in the sandbox reaches production, and nothing in it leaves the instance.
